mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS decline are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with a declining labor force (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression of returns on the interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5%, it indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate profitability, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5%, or the effect size is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000, it indicates a weakening real estate market that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive change in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter signals strong economic growth that supports corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of positive GDP change are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and housing starts (HOUST) are falling, it indicates supply chain disruption coupled with weak real estate demand, reducing corporate profitability and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising INDPRO and falling HOUST fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression of returns on the interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeding 230, central bank actions increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 230, or the effect size is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression.
